tool.name: grep
tool.description: Search files or directories inside the target repository (--repo) for lines matching a regex pattern. Useful for locating tool registrations, system prompts, HTTP/command/file sinks, secrets, or auth checks.
tool.details: Returns matches formatted as "relative_path:line_number: line_content". - Respects repository boundaries and ignores common build/dependency directories - Skips binary files and files larger than 1 MB - Results are capped at max_results (default 100)

parameters.parameter: Regular expression pattern to search for (e.g. "SYSTEM_PROMPT|web_fetch|subprocess").
Relative or absolute file/directory path inside the repository (defaults to ".").
Whether to recurse into subdirectories (default true).

returns.return: Dictionary with success, pattern, path, match_count, truncated, and newline-separated matches.
